title: DS Transform Machine-Readable Component Spec
description: A machine-readable component specification emitted by ds-transform for AI/agent consumption. Per the JSON-for-structure / Markdown-for-rules split validated by Indeed's benchmark, this JSON carries structured component metadata (name, slots, variants, tokens, states) while human-readable usage rules stay in the prose spec (referenced via docsRef). See docs/design-system-methodology.md section 20.1.

name.description: Component name. Use a namespace-prefixed family name when part of a family (e.g. DataListItem, ChartValue, FieldLabel).

family.description: The parent family/namespace this component belongs to, if any.

description.description: One-sentence statement of the component's role/intent.

slots.description: Named slots (composition). Each slot is a place where an atom or content is injected.

name.description: Slot name, e.g. title, meta, leading, trailing.

accepts.description: What atom/content the slot accepts, e.g. 'Icon | Checkbox', 'text'.

variants.description: Independent variant axes. Keep to the real axes; layout/alignment differences are a variant, not a separate component.

axis.description: Axis name, e.g. size, tone, region, kind.

states.description: Interaction/data states. Prefer referencing a system-wide pattern (via statesRef) over redefining shared states per component.

statesRef.description: Reference to a system-wide state pattern doc when states are shared (empty/loading/error).

tokens.description: Design tokens this component consumes (component-tier tokens referencing semantic tokens).

references.description: Semantic token it maps to, e.g. color-surface-default.

compositionApi.description: How sub-parts are supplied: compound/namespace children, a data array (items), or flat props.

children.description: Child components in the family (item/group decomposition), by name.

accessibility.description: Non-negotiable accessibility rules (ARIA roles/attrs, focus, live-region) encoded for agents.

consolidates.description: As-is source elements this component consolidates (traceability back to the original planning doc).

status.description: Governance status relative to the target design system.

docsRef.description: Path/anchor to the human-readable prose spec (usage rules, do's/don'ts). Structure lives here in JSON; natural-language rules live there in Markdown.
